description: P36 (plan M6-M9 §5.7 side quests, §5.9): deserters of Aldmere's war camp hide at the burned mill. Find them, then spare them (their word for a parley - a token the herald accepts at stage 4 - the war camp's engines marked, 1 iron from their pay chest) or hand them over to the war camp (2 iron). 120 XP. It starts once a stage-4 giant discovers the mill.

stages.objective: Find the deserters hiding at the burned mill
Spare the deserters, or hand them over to the war camp
